doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

chapter: Touring Alabama and Florida, first New Orleans trips
title: Nighthawk Orchestra in Birmingham and the Mac bands
summary: She names the Birmingham Nighthawk Orchestra, a nine-piece band, and other bands she worked in.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: What was this, Nighthawk Orchestra did you say?

Yeah, Birmingham. But I worked at the Nighthawk Orchestra in Birmingham, see. I played, playing, that was when I was in the band, working in the band. You know, but all those different spots like that. Well, when I played in the mother towns, Montgomery, I was with Mac Meadow Makers.
I was with Mac Meadow Makers.

Mm-hm. See. And by I mean, from then on, I've been working with bands. Mac Meadow Makers, Joe Jester Orchestra, Douglas Orchestra. You know. Who had the Nighthawks? Let me see now if I can remember who had that Nighthawks. I really forgot them boys names. Don't remember any of them.
Yeah, they were the big bands.
It was a big band. It was a big band. Nine piece band. God knows, see, I couldn't be more calling them boys names to see my life. But it was a Birmingham band band? Yeah, Birmingham band.
